job.job_description:
GenAI Engineer

4-7 Years

Gurugram




Design and develop AI-powered backend systems leveraging Amazon Bedrock, SageMaker, RAG pipelines, and S3 content sources. Build secure APIs integrating AI capabilities into enterprise applications. Develop prompt engineering frameworks, evaluation harnesses, safety filters, HITL workflows, and quality monitoring mechanisms. Create ETL/ingestion and embeddings pipelines, optimize retrieval performance, and productionize solutions with CI/CD, monitoring, and cost optimization. Collaborate with product, security, compliance, and engineering teams to deliver scalable AI solutions. Build reusable AI accelerators, document best practices, and support go-live readiness. Immediate joiners or candidates serving a notice period of 710 days preferred. Previous MNC experience mandatory.




Key skills:




Python, GenAI/LLM, AWS (Bedrock, SageMaker, S3, Lambda, Step Functions, CloudWatch, IAM), LangChain, LangGraph, RAG, HITL Patterns, pgvector, OpenSearch Vector Search, Pandas, Spark, DynamoDB, PostgreSQL, Docker, Kubernetes, Git, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Microservices, Event-Driven Architecture, Prompt Engineering, ReactJS (Preferred), Copilot
job.ai_reason: Strong production RAG experience and transferable cloud skills.
